== PC Discord and Retro Club facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added the field size from the Worlds wrap-up and the streaming of one match per round (quickdraw3457 [KAGI] in #alternate-formats, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (19 October 2021), [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/749418802441093192/900099703323111474 Discord message]; JaredNap in #alternate-formats, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (14 October 2021), [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/749418802441093192/898183728487088128 Discord message]).
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The lead gives "the published field of 16" and the Finish table lists 16 players. The Players Committee's 2021 Worlds wrap-up gives a field of 15, and Matt Carulli wrote on Discord that "it was 15 people when only 1 or 2 dropped". The [[2021 World Championship]] side-events entry records the same 15/16 difference. Both values stay on the page.
=== Missing data ===
* Left out: Matt Carulli's view that it was the most successful non-Open side event the Players Committee had run so far (opinion), and the deck records he and Jared Napolitano gave for their Watch Your Step decks (game counts per side are not clear from the posts).
